title: Structure Looting
description: The &6Screwdriver&r is used to rotate conveyor blocks aswell as to create a &3Chicago Pile&r. It can also be used in combination with &6Bobby Pins&r to unlock &6Safes&r found in various structures.
The &6Crowbar&r is used to open crates for loot such as food and ammunition found in various structures.
&6Uranium-238&r can be found in structures and can be used to skip the &3Desh Anvil&r after obtaining a &3Crucible&r.
